# TamizhTech Robotics Company

Coimbatore-based indigenous design and fabrication robotics company. 
Established: 22 October 2024 (LLC). Evolved from Tamizh Robotics Club (est. 2021).
Founder: Er. K. Tamizharasan.
Headquarters: Thiruchendur Gdn Rd, Kurumbapalayam, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India - 641107.

## Brand Tagline
- **Tamil**: தமிழின் தொழில்நுட்பம், நாளைய உலகிற்காக
- **English**: Tamizh Technology for Tomorrow’s World

## Key Metrics
- **Wins**: 180+ Podium Wins in National & State-Level Robotics Tournaments
- **Students Trained**: 1000+ Students Trained (STEM programs & workshops)
- **Partners**: 15+ Industry & School Partners
- **Events**: 200+ events and training projects organized

## Core Offerings

### 1. B2B Industrial Automation
- Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs) & Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) material handling fleets
- PLC Control Cabinets & Panel wiring setups
- SCADA Dashboard interfaces & reporting systems
- High-speed computer vision quality inspection benches

### 2. STEM & AI School Labs (K-12)
- Turnkey lab setups for CBSE/ICSE schools
- Mapped curriculum for Grades 1-12
- 3D printers, modular electronics, and C++ firmware training packages
- Atal Tinkering Labs (ATL) compliance frameworks

### 3. Robotics Competition Kits (E-Store)
- **RC Robo Race**: High-RPM metal gear motors, drift chassis, carbon fiber structure.
- **RC Robo Soccer**: Pneumatic active striker, omni-directional wheels, customized RC remote.
- **RC Robo Sumo**: Rare-earth magnets, high-traction tires, heavy armored steel base.
